text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation and removal of on-street accessible parking spaces for persons with disabilities.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation and removal of on-street accessible parking spaces at the locations identified in Attachment 1 to the report (March 13, 2026) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services, as amended by the following: a. amended Table 1: On-street Accessible Parking Spaces to be installed, by adding the following location in Ward 5: “Corbett Avenue, south side, between a point 87 metres west of Mould Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further west.”
